substeps.caption: A storage tray: what the arm picks from. 1760 x 760 mm and 300 mm tall; the tray's right end stays free for its UPS and dock.
Charge cups turned from 5N Al (blue rack) and C10100 Cu (orange rack), 48 of each, in the front rows where a level gripper takes them.
Their plugs, Al and Cu apart; 54 capped 20 mL vials; 112 15 mL ICP-MS tubes.
The top drawer: 96 SEM pin stubs, 12.7 mm, carbon tabs on.
The lower drawer: 32 polished 1.25 in mounts.
Tensile bars (E8 sub-size), sealed 250 mL powder jars with lids by powder, labelled bins.
Every pocket is a seat: storage_seats() lists them for the arm's planner.
